title: Plan bounded async retry helper
prompt: Inspect the small target project and provide a concise implementation plan for adding retry_async(operation, attempts=3, base_delay=0.01). It must retry only ordinary Exceptions, use exponential backoff, reject attempts < 1, and re-raise the last exception. Identify the relevant files and tests. Do not modify files.
quality_review: Plan identifies the target module and test file from inspected workspace contents.
Plan covers validation, retry boundary, exponential delay, final exception, and tests.
No implementation or unrelated work is proposed.

title: Fix zero-size chunk boundary
prompt: Fix chunk(items, size) so size <= 0 raises ValueError while preserving normal chunking. The target includes a regression test. Make the minimal code change, do not alter tests, and run the relevant tests.
quality_review: Production code is fixed without changing or weakening tests.
The regression and existing behavior tests pass.
No unrelated files or behavior are changed.

title: Audit multi-file seeded project (tokens, logs, hardcoded keys, lifecycle)
prompt: Perform a read-only security audit of the seeded mini-project (config.py, storage.py, api_client.py). Check token handling and defaults, secrets or personal data in logs, hardcoded credentials, broad exception handling, temporary-file and permission lifecycle, and request safety (certs/timeouts). Report only evidence-backed findings with severity (critical/high/medium/low), exact file and line, impact, and remediation. Do not modify files.
quality_review: Findings cover only confirmed issues in config.py / storage.py / api_client.py.
Recognizes the development-token fallback, header logging, hardcoded key, broad except and request-safety issues, with evidence and impact.
No files are modified and speculative issues are excluded.
